_comment: A1: original HF endpoint, effective batch 256 (single step, no accumulation), same 15-epoch cosine and same 4500 sample exposure target.

ablation.name: A1_hf_b256
ablation.notes: Batch-256 counterpart of A0, realized as microbatch 128 x accumulation 2: the relu2 attention keeps two full [B,heads,Q,K] tensors alive, so a single 256 forward needs >12GB on this card (measured: mb128 peak 7.39GB, mb256 OOM). 4500/(128*2) = 17-18 optimizer steps per epoch, so epoch 4 lands at ~70 updates.
